item.title: Deliberations Begin in Trial of Probationer Accused of Causing Deadly Wreck
item.description: Jury deliberations began Tuesday in the trial of a 27-year-old probationer accused of causing a deadly head-on wreck in Winchester while driving under the influence. Willie Eddie Salazar of Wildomar allegedly killed 32-year-old Sahtarria Anderson of Menifee in 2022.
